{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lindemor tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] with dazzling green leaves. It was one of the many trees found on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Gala]]. Within [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda's]] palace walls, a large Lindemor tree was planted.<ref name="JA">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>
